question: What is the assistance to be given to the elderly, per person per month, after the age of 60 years, under the 'Jiyo Parsi' Scheme with effect from 22 October 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rs. 10,000**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Under the** 'Jiyo Parsi' Scheme**, the assistance provided to the elderly, per person per month, after the **age of 60 years**, with effect from **22 October 2021**, is **Rs. 10,000**.
 
• The 'Jiyo Parsi' Scheme aims to **reverse the decline in the Parsi population by adopting a scientific protocol and structured interventions**.
 
• This scheme includes financial assistance and medical interventions to support Parsi couples in having children.
 
• The scheme also provides support to elderly Parsis to ensure their well-being and quality of life.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The 'Jiyo Parsi' Scheme is an initiative of the **Ministry of Minority Affairs**, Government of India.
 
• The scheme was **launched in 2013** to address the declining population of the Parsi community in India.
 
• It includes components such as advocacy, health interventions, and financial support to encourage Parsi families to have more children.
 
• The scheme has been successful in increasing the number of Parsi births and providing necessary support to the elderly in the community.
 
• The financial assistance for the elderly under the scheme helps in managing their healthcare and living expenses, ensuring they lead a dignified life.
